title: Chicken and parsnip tray bake
summary: Chicken and parsnip tray bake is a british dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and parsnips, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Chicken and parsnip tray bake into even pieces and toss parsnips with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of parsnips while you season skinless chicken thigh fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle skinless chicken thigh fillets and red onions among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken and parsnip tray bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Chicken and parsnip tray bake into warm bowls with the juices.
